data.headline: ELME’s filings show a continuing Washington-area property liquidation and planned NYSE delisting

claims.text: ELME linked its NYSE delisting notice to intended dissolution and cancellation of its common shares.

citation.quote: On September 29, 2026, in connection with its intended dissolution and the cancellation of its common shares of beneficial interest, par value $0.01 per share

claims.text: ELME completed the disposition of 3801 Connecticut Avenue, a 307-unit Washington, DC community, for $55.0 million.

citation.quote: On September 28, 2026, Elme 3801 Connecticut Ave Trustee LLC, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Elme Communities, a Maryland real estate investment trust (the “Company”), completed its previously announced disposition of 3801 Connecticut Avenue, a 307-unit community located in Washington, DC, for a purchase price of $55.0 million

claims.text: ELME also completed the disposition of The Kenmore, a 371-unit Washington, DC community, for $55.0 million.

citation.quote: Also on September 28, 2026, Elme Kenmore LLC, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company, completed its previously announced disposition of The Kenmore, a 371-unit community located in Washington, DC, for a purchase price of $55.0 million, subject to certain customary adjustments and prorations

claims.text: The Bethesda disposition was amended to close on or before August 11, 2026 after the buyer assignment.

citation.quote: Bethesda Seller and Tilden Bethesda Hill Apartments, LLC, as assignee of Bethesda Buyer, amended the Bethesda Agreement on July 23, 2026 to provide for the closing of the sale of Elme Bethesda on or before August 11, 2026.

claims.text: The filings describe property-sale proceeds as a source for repaying the Secured Term Loan, with sold properties released from its mortgages.

citation.quote: For each of these sales, a portion of the net proceeds was used to repay a portion of the Secured Term Loan, and those sold properties were released from the mortgages securing the Secured Term Loan.

claims.text: Riverside sale proceeds funded repayment in full of the remaining Term Loan obligations and termination of the related loan documents.

citation.quote: On September 14, 2026, the Company used a portion of the proceeds from the sale of Riverside Apartments, as described in more detail below, to cause the repayment in full of all remaining indebtedness, liabilities and other obligations under, and terminated, the Loan Agreement and other loan documents evidencing the Term Loan.

claims.text: ELME anticipated filing its Form 25 with the SEC and NYSE on October 26, 2026 for the common-share delisting.

citation.quote: The Company anticipates filing a Form 25, or Notification of Removal from Listing, with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”) and the NYSE relating to the delisting of the Common Shares on October 26, 2026.
